title: Recognition annotation pair
description: Two-annotator recognition annotation contract (E14-R07, ADR 0359). Contains no raw audio: only onset/strum/chord annotations for a clip, each carrying a required provenance (auto|human|reviewed). Enforced by hand-written validation in RecognitionAnnotationParser (no schema-library dependency, matching ADR 0354 D8's precedent) rather than a generic JSON-Schema library.

schemaVersion.description: Annotation contract schema version. The parser rejects any value other than the one it supports (currently "1.0") as a typed InvalidSchemaVersion failure.

annotatorId.description: Identifies which annotator produced this set, so an AgreementReport can name both sides.

events.description: Point-in-time onset/strum annotations. Two events of the same "type" at the same timeMs are a typed overlap failure (ADR 0359 D3).

chordSegments.description: Chord-label intervals. Two segments whose [startMs, endMs) ranges intersect are a typed overlap failure (ADR 0359 D3); segments that merely touch at a boundary do not overlap.

direction.description: Required when type is "strum" (a strum event without it is a typed missing-field failure); forbidden for any other type.

provenance.description: Required on every event. A missing value is a typed failure, never defaulted to "human"; the parser never promotes "auto" to "human" or "reviewed" on its own (ADR 0359 D2).
